evidence_scope: criterion_ids identify relevant comparison views, not proof that a criterion passes. PNGs are unretouched browser captures. Finite samples cannot prove unseen states, source facts or continuous behavior. Keep the original rubric; use needs_review if missing evidence determines the GSB decision.
